A LITTLE CLOSER

Meet Iqri.

You know the words by heart.
Make space for their meaning.

Iqri follows your Arabic recitation and brings the translation of the current ayah into focus. Read in your preferred language, with Quranic Arabic alongside it whenever you like.

This early version recognizes Hafs recitation. Recognition can be delayed or uncertain, especially for short or repeated verses. When the same words occur in several places, Iqri asks for more context instead of claiming an exact location.

Built on open work

Recognition: Quran ASR Small by Abdeladim Fadheli (MIT), with Quran matching utilities from Tilawi Quran ASR. Quran text: Tanzil Project (CC BY 3.0).

Microphone feedback and quiet-input diagnostics adapt WhimprFlow (MIT). The Arabic Quran model identifies your recitation; no AI rewriting is applied to the Quran or its translations.

Translations & sources

Translations convey interpretations of the Quran’s meaning. They are displayed from attributed editions, without AI-generated rewriting.
